d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how diplomatic tensions have flared between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda after DR Congo’s foreign ministry summoned Uganda’s top envoy in Kinshasa over social media posts by Ugandan military chief General Muhoozi Kainerugaba. In posts on X, Kainerugaba—the son of President Yoweri Museveni—appeared to endorse a rebel advance on Walikale, a territory in eastern DR Congo rich in tin and gold, while warning foreign mercenaries with the threat of execution and vowing to protect the Bahima community. Kinshasa called the remarks deeply serious…
